Episode 79: The Infamous Black Crow
A notorious gangster named Black Crow, who looks like Dilruba, resurfaces in the crime world. Dilruba is caught in the web weaved by Black Crow, who wants to use Dilruba due to resemblance with him. Keshav decides to exploit this opportunity and informs Prema that Dilruba is dead.
